exercises.title: Construct discrete and indiscrete spaces
exercises.objective: Compare the largest and smallest topologies.

exercises.title: Construct Sierpinski space
exercises.objective: Use the particular-point construction at true on Bool.
success: the singleton false is not open

exercises.title: Construct a particular-point topology
exercises.objective: Keep exactly empty sets and sets containing zero open.
success: a particular point set is open

exercises.title: Construct the cofinite topology
exercises.objective: Use finite complements and reserve infinite claims for general proofs.

checks.lean:
example : ¬ T5.indiscreteOnNat.IsOpen {0} := by
  simp [T5.indiscreteOnNat, LeanCraftGame.Topology.indiscrete, Set.ext_iff]
  exact ⟨1, Nat.one_ne_zero⟩
checks.message: The natural-number indiscrete space must not open singleton `{0}`.
At zero, singleton `{1}` is nonempty and does not contain the particular point.

hints.hint: Use the particular-point topology at `true`, not at `false` and not the discrete topology.
